essence: Transform geometrically remaps the incoming layer image at its point in the effect stack: it places an anchor, then scales, shears, rotates, positions, and fades the pixels. Its main causal levers move the anchor’s screen location or change the image’s geometry around that anchor; it does not create new imagery or distort pixels locally.
when_to_use: reposition or resize a layer without using layer transforms
rotate, scale, or skew an effect result
移动、缩放、旋转图层效果
给效果后的画面做位移或旋转
manifests_as: The whole incoming image appears moved, resized, rotated, sheared, and/or faded as one flat transformed result, with empty transparent areas revealed around it when it no longer fills the frame.

key_levers.name: Anchor Point
key_levers.effect: Sets the image-space pivot: Scale, Skew, and Rotation act around this point, while Position places that pivot in the output frame.

key_levers.name: Position
key_levers.effect: Moves the transformed image by placing its Anchor Point at this output coordinate; animate it for a clean whole-image translation.

key_levers.name: Uniform Scale
key_levers.effect: Gates whether the two Scale values are linked: enabled keeps proportional sizing, while disabled permits independent horizontal and vertical stretching.

key_levers.name: Scale X
key_levers.effect: Changes horizontal size around the Anchor Point; values above 100 enlarge, values between 0 and 100 shrink, and negative values mirror horizontally.

key_levers.name: Scale Y
key_levers.effect: Changes vertical size around the Anchor Point; values above 100 enlarge, values between 0 and 100 shrink, and negative values mirror vertically.

key_levers.name: Skew
key_levers.effect: Shears the image into a slant rather than rotating it; the sign chooses the lean direction and Skew Axis chooses the shear orientation.

key_levers.name: Skew Axis
key_levers.effect: Rotates the direction along which Skew is applied; it has no visible effect while Skew is 0.

key_levers.name: Rotation
key_levers.effect: Rotates the entire image around the Anchor Point; animate it for spin or tilt, often alongside Position to keep a subject centered.

key_levers.name: Opacity
key_levers.effect: Fades the transformed result after its geometric change; 0 makes it invisible and 100 leaves its alpha unchanged.

enums_to_verify.Sampling (ADBE Geometry2-0012, 1-2): Unverified belief: selects the transform resampling method/quality, likely a lower-quality faster mode versus a higher-quality smoother mode.
enums_to_verify.GPU Rendering (ADBE Force CPU GPU, 1-3): Unverified belief: selects automatic/CPU/GPU rendering behavior and affects performance or implementation rather than the intended geometry.
enums_to_verify.Use Composition’s Shutter Angle (ADBE Ge: Unverified belief: checkbox-like gate; enabled uses the composition shutter angle for Transform motion blur, disabled uses this effect's Shutter Angle value.

config_recipes.Centered proportional punch-in: Anchor Point [320,180]; Position [320,180]; Uniform Scale 1; Scale X 125; Scale Y 125; Rotation 0; Opacity 100.
config_recipes.Independent widescreen stretch: Uniform Scale 0; Scale X 135; Scale Y 85; Skew 0; Rotation 0; Opacity 100.
config_recipes.Perspective-like slant: Uniform Scale 1; Scale X 105; Scale Y 105; Skew 25; Skew Axis 0; Rotation 0; Position [320,180].
config_recipes.Spin-and-fade exit: Anchor Point [320,180]; animate Position away from [320,180], Rotation from 0 to 45, Scale X/Y from 100 to 115, and Opacity from 100 to 0.

reasoning_hooks: Anchor Point is the pivot and Position is where that pivot lands; changing Anchor Point without compensating Position can make the image appear to jump.
Uniform Scale must be disabled before Scale X and Scale Y can intentionally create non-proportional stretching.
Skew Axis is inert at Skew 0; choose Skew magnitude first, then rotate its axis only if the shear leans in the wrong direction.
Negative Scale values do not merely shrink: crossing 0 flips the image and can create a sudden mirror transition.
This effect transforms the pixels arriving from effects above it in the stack; effects below it process the already transformed result.
At defaults it is visually neutral: Anchor Point and Position coincide, scale is 100%, and Skew/Rotation are 0.
